remarks: ALL UTILITIES INCLUDED in this 1-Bedroom Rental in beautiful Cranbury! Legal basement apartment for single professional with separate entrance. Landlord pays heat, electricity, water, hot water! The unit is a few steps down but experiences great light and the perfect flow! This 1 Bedroom unit includes a full bath, galley-style kitchen with full size electric range, dishwasher, microwave and a built-in nook - perfect for a home office. Full-size washer/dryer, new carpeting in living room and bedroom. Bedroom includes closets with built-in shelving. On-street parking for one car. Strictly NO PETS!! Live in one of the most beautiful areas of Norwalk!
